displayRecipes.purpose: Expose inventory, CRS, processing type, provenance, domain, amplitude stats, and data confidence.

displayRecipes.purpose: Reserve reviewed faults, horizons, targets, and annotations as separate interpreted layers.

audiencePresets.label: Investor overview volume

caveats: Uses one representative Phase 3 processed 3D product.
MT is co-rendered as a separate source-derived inversion visualization.

audiencePresets.label: Investor clean slice
audiencePresets.summary: Readable single inline section for discussions where volume rendering is too dense.

audiencePresets.label: 3D time volume flythrough
audiencePresets.summary: Raymarched PSTM time-domain product with time-scaled vertical display.

audiencePresets.label: Line 301 theatre
audiencePresets.summary: Curated Line 301 PSDM curtain with enhanced/unenhanced comparison visible.
caveats: Displays both enhanced and unenhanced processed products.

audiencePresets.label: Line 302 theatre
audiencePresets.summary: Curated Line 302 PSDM curtain with enhanced/unenhanced comparison visible.
caveats: Displays both enhanced and unenhanced processed products.

audiencePresets.label: Integrated geophysics
audiencePresets.summary: Seismic plus MT resistivity, tuned to show GeoSee's multi-method value proposition.
caveats: Seismic and MT are separate geophysical methods shown together.

audiencePresets.label: Data room inventory
audiencePresets.summary: Provenance-first view for product counts, source submissions, CRS, and confidence badges.
caveats: Inventory metadata remains browser-ready and source-traceable.

audiencePresets.label: Export Line 301 section
audiencePresets.summary: PDF-ready Line 301 layout metadata with legend, scale, CRS, source, date, and caveat text.
caveats: The export layout is a report-supporting visual, not a compliance certification.

derivedViews.label: Amplitude strength
derivedViews.basis: envelope-style magnitude derived from processed amplitude tiles
derivedViews.caveat: Experimental display aid; not an interpreted structure or target.

derivedViews.label: Edge / gradient emphasis
derivedViews.basis: local amplitude-gradient enhancement on source-derived tiles
derivedViews.caveat: Experimental continuity cue; not an automatic fault pick.

derivedViews.label: Coherence-like discontinuity
derivedViews.basis: neighborhood similarity proxy for discontinuity screening
derivedViews.caveat: Screening layer only; manual interpretation required before use.

derivedViews.label: Horizon-following slice
derivedViews.basis: manually reviewed horizon surface sampled against seismic volume
derivedViews.caveat: Requires reviewed horizon basis before being shown as interpretation.

interpretationLayers.label: Reviewed faults
interpretationLayers.caveat: No seismic reflector is auto-labeled as a fault or mineralized structure.

interpretationLayers.label: Reviewed horizons
interpretationLayers.geometry: section picks and optional horizon surfaces
interpretationLayers.caveat: Horizons must be manually reviewed before investor or regulatory display.

interpretationLayers.label: Target corridors
interpretationLayers.caveat: Target corridors are interpreted overlays and must not imply mineralization without review.

interpretationLayers.label: Presentation annotations
interpretationLayers.caveat: Annotations should distinguish measured, processed, and interpreted content.

exportLayouts.label: Investor slide overview
exportLayouts.caveat: Report-supporting visual only; not a mineral resource estimate or regulatory disclosure package.

exportLayouts.label: Technical section layout
exportLayouts.caveat: Processed seismic display for technical review; interpretation requires qualified professional review.

exportLayouts.label: QP report support layout
exportLayouts.caveat: Prepared as report-supporting visualization; it does not by itself satisfy NI 43-101 or S-K 1300 disclosure requirements.
